WHAT I CREATE

Three ways to make
your moment special.

01 / MEHENDI

Mehendi Artist

Bridal, festive and custom mehendi designed around your occasion. From delicate florals to traditional patterns, every section is planned to feel balanced, intricate and personal.

Personalised names, motifs, peacocks, florals and story-inspired elements can be worked into the design according to your preference.

Enquire for mehendi →
02 / PENCIL ART

Pencil Artist

Detailed hand-drawn pencil portraits created from reference photos, with attention to facial features, expressions, texture and shading.

A portrait can turn a favourite photograph into a thoughtful keepsake, birthday gift, anniversary memory or personal artwork.

Enquire for pencil art →
03 / MAKEUP

Makeup Artist

Elegant makeup looks for bridal events, celebrations and special occasions, with a focus on a polished finish that still feels like you.

The look can be discussed around your outfit, event, preferred finish and overall style before the appointment.

Enquire for makeup →

A CREATIVE APPROACH

Art that feels personal.

Dharshini's Artistry brings together three creative services under one simple idea: the final result should feel special to the person receiving it. Whether it is a bridal mehendi, a pencil portrait made from a favourite photograph, or makeup for an important day, the focus is on clean detailing, thoughtful design and a finish you can feel confident about.
